children.text: Last night, we hosted another Client Advisory Board dinner, and it was such a wonderful evening. The main purpose of these dinners is to connect with our clients, share ideas, and enjoy a little time together outside the usual workday. We accomplished just that.

We had a great meal at Atomic Cowboy filled with pizzas bigger than the size of our heads and delectable garlic knots. Not only did the night consist of delicious food, but there were also plenty of laughs, and some really meaningful conversations. It truly reminded us why these connections are so important.
We can’t forget the fun highlight of the night—someone actually guessed the exact number of kisses in the jar! We’re still thoroughly impressed.

A big thank you to everyone who came out. Your time, insights, and partnership mean the world to us. We had such a great time and we hope you did too. Nights like this are a reminder that it’s the people and connections that make all the hard work worthwhile.
Here’s to more dinners, more laughs, and more good conversation in the future!
